outcome: Duration of active phase of labour
Duration of second stage of labour
Maternal complications (PPH, fever, vomiting, hyperstimulation of uterus)
cohort: 200 pregnant women, divided into induced (study) and spontaneous (control) groups
finding: Induced labour was associated with a longer duration of active phase and second stage of labour, higher caesarean section rates, and similar neonatal outcomes compared to spontaneous labour, except for lower 1-minute and 5-minute APGAR scores in the induced group.
